name: xo
author: KrmaL
description: Spam between the spikes above the blue pad as the wave at 66% and then go between the ball portal and blocks to stay as the wave. Move to the floor at 67%. Spam between the one block gap at 69% (don’t touch the UFO portal) and then navigate through the gameplay as the wave until you can move to the ceiling at 72%. Avoid the slope with the pink orbs at 74% and then the triple spike at 75%. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
